method.cache_kind: intended hit/miss is generator selection, not evidence of an actual cache hit
method.cpu: cumulative root+live descendants+waited descendants; nearest measurement endpoints; full first/last endpoints also retained
method.host_cpu: busy excludes idle+iowait; first eight /proc/stat fields avoid guest double count
method.latency_unit: microseconds; correct completions only; nearest-rank p50/p95/p99
method.memory: KiB; sampled RSS tree sums double-count shared pages; PSS null when unavailable; USS never inferred
method.pairing: adjacent opposite implementations within profile, in execution order; descriptive small-sample comparisons, no significance claim
method.qtype: wire QTYPE; A includes both direct A answers and CNAME-to-A workload
method.quantiles: window summaries are not pooled; comparisons use median of window metrics
method.workers: observed first/last worker samples only; exit CPU after final sample can be missing

publication_note: Per-window evidence; paired aggregate comparisons are in comparison.json. Full unrestricted analyzer output remains in the private evidence archive.

memory_temporal.interpretation: short-window temporal observations only; not a memory-leak test
